tagline.en: Singapore-based eSIM with never-expiring data — free 250MB global trial
tagline.zh: 新加坡eSIM：流量永不过期，250MB全球免费试用

description.en: Eskimo (Datapro Technologies Pte Ltd, Singapore) sells eSIMs whose fixed-plan data never expires — 2-year validity from first connect, leftover data extends 2 more years on any new purchase. Official prices (2026-09): Singapore 1GB $3.90 (promo $2.54), 10GB $17.90 (promo $11.64), Global 126-country 10GB $38.90/$23.90. New users get a free 250MB Global eSIM. Rides Singtel 4G/5G in Singapore.
description.zh: Eskimo（新加坡 Datapro Technologies 运营）主打套餐流量永不过期——首次联网起 2 年有效，再购任意套餐可将剩余流量再续 2 年。官方价（2026-09）：新加坡 1GB 3.90 美元（促销 2.54）、10GB 17.90（促销 11.64）、全球 126 国 10GB 38.90/23.90。新用户免费领 250MB 全球 eSIM。新加坡走 Singtel 4G/5G。

details.en:
Eskimo's differentiator is permanence: fixed plans never expire (2-year validity clock starts at first network connect; buying any new plan extends leftover data another 2 years), and data is shareable/transferable between Eskimo users. Singapore plans are powered by Singtel 4G/5G per the official plan page; Global plans cover 111–126 countries.

Official prices (2026-09): Singapore 1GB $3.90/$2.54 promo, 3GB $7.90/$5.14, 5GB $10.90/$7.09, 10GB $17.90/$11.64; Global 10GB $38.90/$23.90. Free tier: 250MB Global eSIM for new users, 111+ countries, no expiry (official banner; the 500MB figure circulating in communities was not found on official pages). App-exclusive 35% off first purchase (capped $12).

Community single-user hands-on (2026-09, unverified): Singapore native IP plus residential IP, high IP quality, speeds good — but pricing is felt expensive. Premium positioning: big Global bundles reach $474.90 (200GB).
details.zh:
Eskimo 的卖点是「永久」：固定套餐永不过期（首次联网起算 2 年，再购任意套餐可把剩余流量再延 2 年），且流量可在用户间共享/转赠。新加坡套餐官方页标注走 Singtel 4G/5G；全球套餐覆盖 111–126 国。

官方价（2026-09）：新加坡 1GB 3.90/促销 2.54 美元、3GB 7.90/5.14、5GB 10.90/7.09、10GB 17.90/11.64；全球 10GB 38.90/23.90。免费额度：新用户 250MB 全球 eSIM、111+ 国、不过期（官方横幅口径；社区流传的 500MB 未在官方页找到）。App 首购专属 35% off（上限 12 美元）。

社区单用户实测（2026-09，未核实）：新加坡原生 IP+住宅 IP、IP 质量高、速率不错——但价格感受偏贵。定位偏高端：大容量全球包可达 474.90 美元（200GB）。

bestFor.en: Users who want data that never expires and top IP quality in Singapore, price-tolerant.
bestFor.zh: 想要流量永不过期、追求新加坡IP质量且对价格不敏感的用户。

note.en: Eskimo (Datapro Technologies Pte Ltd, Singapore; community ties it to Singtel) is widely reported by users to exit in Singapore; the 'Singapore residential IP' claim from the task brief could not be independently confirmed, so IP type stays unknown.
